about.description:
libojph is a C++ JPEG 2000 / High-Throughput JPEG 2000 (HTJ2K) codec built
from a fork of OpenJPH. Besides the 5/3 and 9/7 wavelet kernels, it
encodes and decodes the reversible predict-only kernels rev13 and rev12
(JPEG 2000 Part 2, signalled with ATK markers), so that decoding with r
skipped resolutions returns exactly image[::2**r, ::2**r]. On x86-64 it
dispatches at run time to Google Highway SIMD kernels.

Its files (libojph, include/ojph, lib/cmake/ojph, ojph.pc) do not overlap
with the openjph package, so both can be installed in one environment.
Use it from CMake with find_package(ojph CONFIG REQUIRED) and the target
ojph::ojph, or with pkg-config's ojph module.
about.summary: A fork of OpenJPH (HTJ2K / JPEG 2000) with the rev12 and rev13 reversible kernels, co-installable with OpenJPH.

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "1.1.3"

package:
  name: libojph
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/hmaarrfk/OpenJPH/archive/refs/tags/ojph-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 107a457b9b833b93d4f75797ade4d5c35a2abec07514281dad8886e0023fdd36

build:
  number: 0

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cmake
    - ninja
  host:
    # The Highway kernels are x86-only; other architectures build the generic
    # kernels and do not link libhwy.
    - if: x86_64
      then: libhwy
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage('libojph', upper_bound='x.x') }}

tests:
  - package_contents:
      include:
        - ojph/ojph_codestream.h
        - ojph/ojph_version.h
      lib:
        - ojph
      files:
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/lib/cmake/ojph/ojph-config.cmake
            - Library/lib/pkgconfig/ojph.pc
          else:
            - lib/cmake/ojph/ojph-config.cmake
            - lib/pkgconfig/ojph.pc

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/hmaarrfk/OpenJPH
  repository: https://github.com/hmaarrfk/OpenJPH
  license: BSD-2-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: A fork of OpenJPH (HTJ2K / JPEG 2000) with the rev12 and rev13 reversible kernels, co-installable with OpenJPH.
  description: |
    libojph is a C++ JPEG 2000 / High-Throughput JPEG 2000 (HTJ2K) codec built
    from a fork of OpenJPH. Besides the 5/3 and 9/7 wavelet kernels, it
    encodes and decodes the reversible predict-only kernels rev13 and rev12
    (JPEG 2000 Part 2, signalled with ATK markers), so that decoding with r
    skipped resolutions returns exactly image[::2**r, ::2**r]. On x86-64 it
    dispatches at run time to Google Highway SIMD kernels.

    Its files (libojph, include/ojph, lib/cmake/ojph, ojph.pc) do not overlap
    with the openjph package, so both can be installed in one environment.
    Use it from CMake with find_package(ojph CONFIG REQUIRED) and the target
    ojph::ojph, or with pkg-config's ojph module.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - hmaarrfk
